svg.title: The orchestrator between the LLM and the robots
svg.desc: The orchestrator, a large blue frame, sits between an orange LLM block on the left and three green blocks on the right: Executor, then Skills, ARIAC, then Robots, linked top to bottom. Inside the frame are five checks in order: tag 1 Parse JSON, tag 2 Schema, tag 3 Semantic checks, tag 4 Executor guards, tag 5 Stop conditions. An arrow labeled call goes from the LLM into the frame and an arrow labeled error comes back. An arrow labeled run goes from the frame to the Executor, and an arrow labeled result comes back from the Robots block.
